prompt:
Write a portfolio case study in Markdown for the freelancer Tobias Reyne (Full-stack developer - React, Next.js, Node.js and Postgres).

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Monthly statement PDF generator
client: Alder Property Group
client_industry: real estate
start: 2022-07
end: 2022-09
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Node.js
- BullMQ
- Redis
- Puppeteer
- AWS S3
implied_skills:
- background jobs
- PDF generation
built: A queue that renders owner statements to PDF overnight and stores them in S3
  instead of building them on request.
metrics:
- 12k statements a month
- request timeouts went from daily to none

Requirements:
- 300 to 450 words, first person, a short title line starting with "# ".
- Loosely cover the client's problem, what was built, and the results. Emphasis: the technical approach.
- Include one short code or config snippet (5 to 15 lines) in a fenced block that fits the stack.
- Refer to the client as "Alder Property Group".
- Never use these words or phrases: "background jobs", "PDF generation". Describe the work so a reader can infer them.
